strings.aNo: Umagistrate (ijaji lekhotho kamantji) nguye othatha isiqunto. Ukusebenzisa i-inFORMed akutjho bona ikhotho izokunikela umyalelo, namkha bona amapholisa azokuqinisekisa ukuthi uyalandelwa.
strings.aS1: Thatha iforomo lakho uliyise ku-clerk wekhotho (umsebenzi wekhotho okusizako) kunanyana ngiyiphi i-Magistrates' Court, ngesikhathi ikhotho esebenza ngaso (kanengi ukusuka ngo-9am ukuya ngo-3:30pm ngamalanga wokusebenza). Nangabe usengozini, ungafaka isibawo nangaphandle kwesikhathi sokusebenza kwekhotho. Kumahhala, begodu awutlhogi igqwetha.
strings.aS2: U-clerk wekhotho uhlola iforomo nawe. Ulisayina phambi kwe-commissioner of oaths (umuntu ovunyelweko bona afakazele ukufunga nokusayinwa kwamadokhumenti).
strings.aS3: Umagistrate (ijaji lekhotho kamantji) ufunda iforomo, kanengi ngelanga elifanako. Nangabe umagistrate ubona bona utlhoga ukuvikelwa nje, ukunikela i-interim protection order (umyalelo wekhotho wesikhatjhana wokukuvikela).
strings.aS4: I-interim order inikelwa yena ngusherifu namkha mapholisa. Ikuvikela kusukela ngesikhathi ayifumana ngaso.
strings.aS5: Unikelwa i-return date (ilanga ekufuze ubuyele ngalo ekhotho). Ngelangelo nobabili ningaya ekhotho, umagistrate athathe isiqunto sokobana aninikele i-protection order yokugcina na. Qiniseka bona uya ekhotho ngelangelo.
strings.aS6: Nangabe wephula umyalelo, bikela isiteshi samapholisa osibhale efomorweni lakho. Angabotjhwa.
strings.aboutG1: GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech) yihlangano yeSewula Afrika esebenzisa ithekhnoloji begodu elwela amalungelo wabafazi. Isebenzisa ithekhnoloji ukusekela abantu abasinde ehlakalweni lodlame olusekelwe ebulilini. Ibuye isize abantu bafumane ilwazi, isekelo nezinto abazidingako ngamalungelwabo, ipilwabo nokuphila kwabo kuhle.
strings.aboutI1: inFORMed lithulusi le-AI le-GRIT elisiza abantu bazwisise bona bangafumanaphi isizo lezomthetho. Likhuluma njengomuntu womphakathi onendaba nabanye. Aliphuthumisi namkha lahlulele abantu. Lisiza abantu abaqalene nodlame lwangekhaya batlole okwenzeka kibo esibaweni ikhotho engathatha igadango ngaso.
strings.aboutI2: Iseluleko salo sisekelwe eforomeni elisemthethweni lokufaka isibawo se-protection order, umyalo wekhotho wokukuvikela. Godu sisekelwe emihlahlandlela emalungana namalungelo wabantu abaqalene nodlame lwangekhaya nokutlola isibawo esiqinileko, erhubhululweni le-MOSAIC ngalokho abomantji abakuqalako, nemhlahlandlela we-GRIT we-protection order.
strings.askDesc: Zwisisa ama-protection order (imiyalelo yekhotho yokuvikela abantu), indlela ikhotho esebenza ngayo namagama wezomthetho.
strings.askOpening: Lotjha, ngiyi-inFORMed. Ngiyi-chatbot ye-AI, angisingumuntu. Angikwazi ukunikela iseluleko sezomthetho. strings.footPw: Isekelwa yi-GRIT · Gender Rights in Tech
strings.g1: Ukusebenza ngendlela ebeka abantu abasinde ehlakalweni qangi nezwa ubuhlungu abadlule kibo, ngokuphepha neendingo zabo kuqakathekiswa ethekhnolojini neenhlelweni zayo.
strings.g2: Ukwakha izinto kunye nemiphakathi, kuhlanganise nabafazi abatjha, abantu abasinde ehlakalweni nabantu lokho abadlule kikho okusiza ekwakhiweni kwamathulusi la.
strings.g3: Isekelo ledijithali elifikeleleka lula, kuhlanganise ne-Zuzi, ithulusi lokucoca elisebenzisa i-AI ngaphakathi kwe-app ye-GRIT, kunye nesekelo elifumaneka ku-WhatsApp namanye amathulusi wedijithali.
strings.g4: Iindlela ezisebenzako zokufumana ukuphepha nesekelo, kuhlanganise nezinto ezifana ne-Panic Button ne-Evidence Vault eziku-app ye-GRIT.
strings.gen: Yenza i-protection order, umyalo wekhotho wokuvikela
strings.generalInfo: Ilwazi elivamileko, aliveli emihlahlandleleni ye-GRIT. Sibawa uhlole nomabhalana wekhotho.
strings.guideAudio: Siyakwamukela ku-inFORMed, evela ku-GRIT. Iwebhusayidi le ikusiza uzalise iforomu lekhotho le-protection order, umyalelo wekhotho wokukuvikela. Kumahala begodu kuyifihlo. Ukuthoma, thinta ibhathini elikhulu elihlaza okwesibhakabhaka elithi: Thoma iforomu lami. Bese usitjela indaba yakho. Akukafuzi uthayiphe. Thinta imayikrofoni ehlaza okwesibhakabhaka bese uyakhuluma, uyithinte godu nawupheza. Bese uthinta Kulalele ukuzwa lokho okuzwakeleko, bese uthinta Thumela nakulungileko, namkha Kutjho godu. Nawuvula Funda ngokuphimisela, yoke ipendulo izokufundelwa. Nawusengozini nje, fonela amapholisa ku-1 0 1 1 1, namkha uthinte ibhathini elibomvu lokuphuma msinya phezulu bona uphume msinya kuwebhusayidi le.
strings.h1: Fumana isizo lokuzalisa iforomo yakho ye-protection order (umyalelo wekhotho wokukuvikela).
strings.hSadag: SADAG umtato wokusiza abantu abasengozini yokuzibulala, ama-awara ayi-24
strings.hTg: Khuluma ne-inFORMed, tlola namkha uthumele umlayezo ngelizwi
strings.hfIntro: Nasi isibawo sakho, sifundwa ngokuzwakalako. Lokhu ngikho ozokufungela ekhotho. Ungathinta u-Jamisa nanyana kunini. Nangabe kukhona okungakalungi namkha okutjhiyiweko, ngitjela engcocweni, namkha ukutjhugulule efomini.
strings.howSub: Abomantji batlhoga imininingwana enqophileko nezwakalako bona bakuphe i-protection order (umyalelo wekhotho wokukuvikela). inFORMed ikusiza bona ubanikele yona, ngaphandle kokobana ikulumo le izwakale ingathi uzalisa iforomo.
strings.iP1: inFORMed yichatbot ye-AI eyenziwe yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Akusimumuntu begodu akusilo igqwetha, begodu ayinikeli isiluleko sezomthetho. Ikusiza ukulungisa isibawo sokuthoma sefomu yekhotho esemthethweni. Unobhala wekhotho e-Magistrates' Court uyayihlola nawe ngaphambi kobana uyisayine.
strings.iP2: Ukuphendula imibuzwakho, inFORMed ithumela imilayezwakho ku-OpenAI, ikhamphani ene-AI eyisebenzisako. GRIT ayiyiboni namkha iyigcine imilayezwakho. OpenAI ibawiwe bona ingayigcini, begodu ayisetjenziselwa ukufundisa nanyana ngiyiphi i-AI.
strings.iP3: Ingxoxo ayigcinwa nakancani: iyaphela nawubulala ikhasi. Ifomu yakho igcinwa efoninapha kwaphela, ekhasini elivulekileko, bona ingalahleki nawulayitjha godu ikhasi. Nawukhetha “Gcina uqede ngemva kwesikhathi”, ikhiywa nge-PIN oyikhethako begodu ihlala efoninapha uze uyisule. Akunamuntu ongayivula ngaphandle kwe-PIN, ngitjho ne-GRIT. I-PIN elitjalweko angeze yatholwa godu.
strings.iP4: Gandelela u-Thoma phasi namkha u-Phuma msinyana ukusula ikhasi. Ukusula ifomu egciniweko, thinta u-“Ragela phambili nesibawo esigciniweko” ekhasini lokuthoma, faka i-PIN yakho bese ukhetha u-“Yisule”. Ifayili ye-PDF namkha ye-Word oyidayinelodileko ihlala kumafayili adayinelodiweko wefonakho uze uyisule.
strings.iP5: Omunye umuntu osebenzisa ifoninapha angabona emlandweni webrawuza bona uvakatjhele i-inFORMed, namkha athole ifomu oyidayinelodileko. Nangabe lokho kungakufaka engozini, sebenzisa ithebhu yangasese (incognito), sula amafayili owadayinelodileko ngemva kokuwasebenzisa, bese usula umlando webrawuza yakho. Ifomu egcinwe nge-PIN ihlala ikhiyiwe. Ethebhini yangasese, ifomu egciniweko iyalahleka nawubulala ithebhu.
strings.iP6: Fownela amapholisa ku-10111 namkha i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428. Kokubili kumahhala. Ungasebenzisa ne-app ye-GRIT, enebhathini lesizo elikuhlanganisa nesizo.
strings.k1: Ungafaka isibawo se-protection order, umyalo wekhotho wokukuvikela, ngokwakho, mahala. Awudingi ummeli begodu awudingi ukuvula icala emapholiseni qangi.
strings.k2: Ufaka isibawo e-Magistrates' Court lapha uhlala khona, usebenza khona namkha ufunda khona, lapho omunye umuntu ahlala khona namkha asebenza khona, namkha lapho ukuhlukunyezwa kwenzeke khona.
strings.k2s: Ikhotho ivamise ukuvulwa ngo-9am kuya ku-3:30pm ngamalanga weveke. Nangabe usengozini, ungafaka isibawo nangemva kwamahora wokusebenza.
strings.k3: Udlame lwangekhaya alukokulimala komzimba kwaphela. Luhlanganisa ukuhlukunyezwa ngokomzwelo, ngemali nangokwamabhayi, ukuhlupha umuntu, ukumthusela nokulawula indlela aziphatha ngayo.
strings.k4: Iinthombe, amanothi wabodorhodere namkha abantu abakubonileko kungasiza, kodwana usengafaka isibawo ngaphandle kwakho. Nomntwana wananyana ngimuphi umnyaka angafaka isibawo.
strings.learnP: Buza nanyana yini ngama-protection order, iimyalelo yekhotho yokukuvikela, ngekhotho namkha ngamagama womthetho. Thayipha namkha ukhulume, begodu ungalalela zoke iimpendulo.

strings.safety.death: Ngiyi-chatbot, begodu lokhu kuzwakala njengesimo esiphuthumako esithinta umuntu. Nangabe unesikhathi sokuhlela bona uphume njani engozini, ngibuze ngehlelo lokuphepha. Nangabe lesi simo esiphuthumako begodu utlhoga isizo nje, fonela i-ambulensi ku-10177 namkha amapholisa ku-10111. Iinomboro lezi zimahhala, ngalokho awutlhogi i-airtime. Ungadawuniloda ne-app ye-GRIT ezokuhlanganisa nesizo usebenzisa isixhumanisi lesi: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele namkha iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.fallback: Ngiyaxolisa, ngibe nomraro wokuphendula nje. Nangabe usengozini, fonela amapholisa ku-10111, namkha i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (mahala, ama-iri ama-24). Ngibawa uthumele umlayezwakho godu.
strings.safety.goodbye: Nangabe uneminye imibuzo, ngibawa ubuye uzokubuza. Ngilapha bona ngikusize nanyana kunini nawutlhogako. Sala kuhle okwakhathesi!
strings.safety.harm_other: Kufuze bona uzwa ubuhlungu khulu bona uzizwe ngale ndlela. Ngiyi-chatbot, ngalokho angihlali ngikwazi ukuzwisisa amazizo wabantu. Isiqhema se-GRIT siyakwazi ukusebenza nabantu abanamazizo abudisi nabuhlungu. Ngibawa ubathumelele umlayezo ku-WhatsApp enomborweni ethi 072 737 8819.
strings.safety.immediate_danger: Ngiyi-chatbot, begodu lokhu kuzwakala ngathi simo esiphuthumako esidinga umuntu. Nangabe unesikhathi sokuhlela ukuthi ungaphuma njani engozini, ngibuze ngehlelo lokuzivikela. Nangabe lesi kusimo esiphuthumako begodu udinga isizo nje, fonela i-ambulensi ku-10177 namkha amapholisa ku-10111. Iinomborezi zisimahla, awudingi i-airtime. Ungadawuniloda ne-app ye-GRIT ezokuxhumanisa nesizo ngesixhumaniswesi: Android - https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ads.apps.kwanele namkha iOS - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/kwanele/id1616602924.
strings.safety.injured_now: Ngiyi-chatbot, begodu lokhu kuzwakala njengesimo esiphuthumako esithinta umuntu. Nangabe unesikhathi sokuhlela bona uphume njani engozini, ngibuze ngehlelo lokuphepha. Nangabe lesi simo esiphuthumako begodu utlhoga isizo nje, fonela i-ambulensi ku-10177 namkha amapholisa ku-10111. Iinomboro lezi zimahhala, ngalokho awutlhogi i-airtime.
strings.safety.rape: Akunamuntu ofanelwe kudlula kilokho odlula kikho. Akusimlandwakho. Ngingakusiza njani?
strings.safety.suicidal: Ngiyazisola khulu bona uzizwa ufuna ukuzibulala, kodwana ngithabe kwamambala bona uzizwe ungakhuluma ngakho. Angisingumuntu, ngalokho kungenzeka ngingakghoni ukukusekela ngendlela ezwisisa koke odlula kikho. Nansi inomboro ye-SADAG. Awutlhogi i-airtime bona ubafonele, begodu kunomuntu ongakusekela 24/7. Inomboro yabo ithi 0800 567 567. Ungaqala newebhusayithi yabo: https://www.sadag.org
strings.safety.support: Nangabe udinga ukukhuluma nomuntu nje, i-GBV Command Centre imahala begodu ivuliwe ama-iri ama-24: 0800 428 428. Ungathumela nomlayezo nge-WhatsApp ku-GRIT ku-072 737 8819. Singajama kancani nanyana kunini nawudinga lokho.
strings.safety.tracking: Anginikeli muntu imininingwana yakho. Ikulumo yethu ayigcinwa ngemva kokobana uyivale.
strings.saveDemo: Ukubulunga kusebenza ekulumisaneni kwamambala, ingasi edemweni.
strings.saveKept: Iforomo lakho liyabekeka nangabe iphepha lizivula godu.
strings.savedPinGo: Kubulungwe esisetjenzisweni lesi nge-PIN yakho. Amatjhuguluko ayabulungwa njengombana uragela phambili.
strings.serverErr: Uxolo, angikghonanga ukufikelela kuseva nje. Sibawa ulinge godu. Nange usengozini, fowunela ku-10111 namkha ku-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428.
strings.sug1: Yini i-protection order, umyalo wekhotho wokuvikela umuntu?
strings.sug5: Iyini i-interim protection order, umyalo wesikhatjhana wokukuvikela?
strings.toAsk: Ngibuze nanyana yini ngama-protection order, imiyalo yekhotho yokuvikela abantu. Iforomo lakho libekiwe, begodu ungabuyela kilo nanyana kunini.
strings.toFill: Asirageleni phambili ngesibawo sakho. Iforomo lakho libekiwe ngesidleni.
strings.typesNone: Iinhlobo zokuhlukunyezwa zizokuvela la njengombana kukhulunywa ngazo.
strings.underDemo: Isibonelo: umuntu owenziweko nekulumiswano ehlelwe kusengaphambili.
strings.underLive: Ikulumiswano yakho iyifihlo. Ikulumiswano ayibulungwa, kodwana iforomo lakho liyabulungwa nange ikhasi livuleka godu.
strings.vCheck: Hlola lokho engikuzwileko ulungise nanyana yini, bese ucindezela ukuthumela.
strings.vFail: Uxolo, angikuzwanga kuhle lokho. Sibawa ulinge godu, namkha utlole.
strings.vNear: Ngiyalalela… {t}. Sekuzokuba 3 imizuzu: thinta imayikrofoni ebomvu msinyana. Ungarekhoda godu ngemva kwalokho.
strings.vNoSupport: Uxolo, ilizwi alisebenzi kusiphequluli lesi. Sibawa utlole.
strings.vPerm: Ngibawa imvumo yokusebenzisa umbhobho wakho. Ungangivumela kusiphequluli sakho, namkha utlole.
strings.vQ: Ngilokhu okutjhilo? Ungatjhugulula amagama, namkha uwalalele.
strings.wa.askMore: Ungatlola, namkha uthumele umlayezo welizwi. Nawufuna isizo ngesibawo sakho, thumela FILL.
strings.wa.code: Wamukelekile ku-inFORMed, esizwa yi-GRIT (Gender Rights in Tech). Ngibawa uthumele ikhowudi yokungena oyiphiweko.
strings.wa.docFail: Ngiyaxolisa, angikakghoni ukuthumela idokhumenti nje. Ngibawa ulinge godu.
strings.wa.general: — Ilwazi elivamileko, elingaveli emihlahlandlela ye-GRIT. Ngibawa uqinisekise nomabhalana wekhotho.
strings.wa.help:
Ungatlola namkha uthumele umlayezo welizwi nanyana kunini. Ungathumela godu:
ASK {about}
FILL ukufumana isizo lokuzalisa isibawo sakho
FORM ukubona isibawo sakho ngendlela esesiyiyo nje
PDF namkha WORD ukusifumana njengedokhumenti
LANGUAGE ukutjhentjha ilimi
DELETE ukusula ikulumiswanesi

Nangabe usengozini nje, fonela amapholisa ku-10111 namkha i-GBV Command Centre ku-0800 428 428 (mahala, ama-iri ama-24).
strings.wa.textOnly: Ngingafunda imilayezo etloliweko nemilayezo yelizwi. Ngibawa utlola, namkha uthumele umlayezo welizwi.
strings.wa.voiceFail: Ngiyaxolisa, angikawuzwa kuhle umlayezo welizwi lowo. Ngibawa ulinge godu, namkha utlola umlayezwakho.
strings.welcomeBack: Siyakwamukela godu. Isibawo sakho sisesenjalo ngendlela ositjhiye ngayo, begodu ungasibona ngesidleni. Siragele phambili na? Ungangitjela nanyana yini ofuna ukuyingezelela namkha ukuyitjhugulula.
